summary: Booking-surface migration with per-event compatibility decisions, real booking verification, and referrer cutover.

capabilities.notes: Recreate the schedule in Google only after an explicit field-level mapping for availability, calendar, duration, buffers, and booking limits.
Repository-owned URLs and embeds can be updated mechanically after the Google schedule passes an unauthenticated test booking.
CRM, email, QR, social, and custom-domain surfaces require an owner-controlled referrer audit and cutover.
Keep existing bookings on Cal.com unless a separately tested record-migration path is approved.
Team routing, payments, notifications, workflows, and webhooks need a deliberate replacement design rather than an implied equivalent.
